metadata.source: Synthetic demonstration ranking guidance; preferences are soft and current-trip choices take precedence.

zh-TW: 優先白天出發
提供會議時間後才比較時程適配
en-US: Prefer daytime departures
Compare meeting fit only after meeting times are provided

zh-TW: 可比較時，優先讓合成航班時刻符合已保存的會議時段。
比較航班時優先白天出發，再比較日期與合成總價；目錄沒有直飛與改票供應資料。
適時詢問會議地點與時間；飯店鄰近度僅供建議。
en-US: Fit synthetic flight times to explicitly saved meeting times when comparable.
Prefer daytime departures, then date flexibility and synthetic total fare; direct-flight availability and changeability are not represented in this catalog.
Ask for meeting location and time when relevant; hotel proximity is advice only.

zh-TW: 優先白天出發
日期彈性與合成總價作為次要排序
en-US: Prefer daytime departures
Then compare date flexibility and synthetic total fare

zh-TW: 比較合成航班時偏好白天出發。
相關時詢問兒童年齡、旅行步調及房間需求。
目錄沒有相鄰座位、兒童服務或家庭房供應資料。
en-US: Prefer daytime departure times when comparing synthetic flights.
Ask for children's ages, travel pace, and room needs when relevant.
Seats together, child services, and family-room availability are not represented.

zh-TW: 優先較低合成總價
再比較日期彈性
en-US: Prefer lower synthetic total fare
Then compare date flexibility

zh-TW: 符合條件的合成報價先按總價排序，再比較日期彈性。
飯店性價比僅供建議；目錄沒有飯店價格或供應資料。
en-US: Rank matching synthetic offers by total price, then date flexibility.
Hotel value is advice only; no hotel prices or availability are cataloged.

zh-TW: 偏好當地白天抵達與出發
再比較飛行時間與合成總價
未選艙等時才採用商務艙軟預設
en-US: Prefer local daytime arrivals and departures
Then compare duration and synthetic total fare
Business cabin is a soft default only before a cabin is chosen

zh-TW: 只有旅客尚未選擇艙等時，才將商務艙當作軟預設。
偏好方便的抵達時間與舒適步調。
目錄沒有飯店品質或會員等級禮遇資料。
en-US: Use business cabin as a soft default only when the traveler has not chosen a cabin.
Prefer convenient arrival times and a comfortable pace.
Hotel quality and member status benefits are not represented.
